text:
nora: Heads up — found ~73 backup objects in prod-archive uploaded with SSE-S3 (AES256) instead of our CMK. Happened ~02:48-02:55 UTC.

kai: Oof. Which principal did the puts? Could be the ad-hoc uploader containers rolled out last night.

encops-bot: Alert INV-2026-05-12-03: s3 PutObject without aws:kms detected (count=73).

jules: Quick CloudTrail grep shows `arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/backup-agent-autoscale` made PutObject calls in that window. There was a deploy at 02:40 that bumped the image. PR 842 updated IAM policy and removed `kms:Encrypt` from the role by mistake.

nora: Immediate steps: 1) disable backup cron for prod-archive, 2) re-add kms:Encrypt to the role, 3) add a bucket policy Deny for non-kms PutObject, 4) plan re-encrypt.

kai: Bucket policy snippet to test in staging: 
```
{
  "Sid":"EnforceKMSEncryption",
  "Effect":"Deny",
  "Principal":"*",
  "Action":"s3:PutObject",
  "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::prod-archive/*",
  "Condition":{
    "StringNotEquals":{"s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption":"aws:kms"}
  }
}
```

jules: For re-encrypt pilot we should use S3 copy with metadata REPLACE to avoid full re-upload. Example: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://prod-archive/backups/2026-05-12T02-50.tar.gz \
  s3://prod-archive/backups/2026-05-12T02-50.tar.gz \
  --metadata-directive REPLACE --server-side-encryption aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/fa1b2c3d
```
Be careful with KMS QPS — throttle workers and watch CloudWatch for ThrottledRequests and KMSThrottles.

compliance: I'll start the customer impact assessment. If any PII in affected snapshots we follow our data incident playbook and notify legal.

nora: Also adding a detection rule: EventBridge filter for s3 PutObject where `requestParameters.x-amz-server-side-encryption` != "aws:kms" AND tag backup:true. PagerDuty if > 3 in 10m.

kai: I'll revert PR 842 and re-run CI checks to ensure no IAM regression. Add an integration test asserting backup-agent role has `kms:Encrypt` and CI will fail fast if missing.

encops-bot: INC-1922 created by nora, assigned: kai, jules. Pilot re-encrypt ETA ~40m.
